ma.getBLEDeviceCharacteristics(Object object)

Get all characteristics of a service of a Bluetooth low energy device (minimum version: 24.6.0)

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
deviceId String Yes Bluetooth device id
serviceId string Yes Bluetooth service UUID. You need to call ma.getBLEDeviceServices first to obtain
success Function No Callback function for a successful API call.
fail Function No Callback function for a failed API call.
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used whether the API call succeeds or fails.)

object.success Callback Function

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Description
errMsg String getBLEDeviceCharacteristics: ok
characteristics Array Device characteristics list

Array characteristics

Object ArrayItem
Attribute Type Description
uuid String UUID of Bluetooth device characteristics
properties Object Operation types supported by this feature
Object properties
Attribute Type Description
broadcast Boolean Whether the feature supports broadcast operations
read Boolean Whether this feature supports read operations
write Boolean Whether this feature supports write operations
notify Boolean Whether this feature supports notify operation
indicate Boolean Whether the feature supports indicate operation
writeNoResponse Boolean Whether this feature supports no-reply write operations
signedWrite Boolean Whether this feature supports signed write operations
extendedProperties Boolean Whether the feature supports extended attributes
notifyEncryption Boolean Whether this feature supports encrypted notify operation (only related to IOS)
indicateEncryption Boolean Whether this feature supports encryption indicate operation (only related to IOS)

Sample Code

ma.getBLEDeviceCharacteristics({
  deviceId,
  serviceId,
  success: (res) => {
    ma.showModal({
      title: 'getBLEDeviceCharacteristics success',
      content: JSON.stringify(res),
      showCancel: false
    })
    for (let i = 0; i < res.characteristics.length; i++) {
      const item = res.characteristics[i]
      if (item.properties.read) {
        ma.readBLECharacteristicValue({
          deviceId,
          serviceId,
          characteristicId: item.uuid
        })
      }
      if (item.properties.write) {
        console.log('write')
        this.writeBLECharacteristicValue()
      }
    }
  },
  fail(res) {
    ma.showModal({
      title: 'getBLEDeviceCharacteristics fail',
      content: JSON.stringify(res),
      showCancel: false
    })
  }
})
